meaning:
ἔννυχος, -ον
(νύξ), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:5 * ;] (in cl. poët.; prose in late Gk. only)
nightly. Neut., adverbially, ἔννυχα (Rec. -χον), by night: Mrk.1:35.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
